summary: Retained 1 modified protein residues with compatible named residue templates; covalent modifications are not removed as heterogens.
Explicitly removed 0 existing hydrogens before pH reassignment, 0 water heavy atoms, and 0 other heavy atoms.
Added 92 heavy/terminal atoms across existing residues and 1 rebuilt internal segment(s).
Prepared 1 ligands with GAFF2 / AM1-BCC; bound heavy atoms retained, chosen formal charges and atom mappings recorded.
Bounded steric chi sampling accepted 17 lower-overlap angle changes across 200 examined residues.
Added 2411 hydrogens at requested pH 7; actual residue states and bonded-H inventories are recorded.

Built 12 missing internal residues with ProMod3 and bounded OpenMM refinement; complete-complex loop geometry and chirality checks passed. Construction methods and attempts are recorded in loop-model-provenance.json.
warnings: Protonation uses OpenMM template/heuristic pH rules, not computed residue pKa values or constant-pH dynamics.
TPO A:170: Fixed dianionic phosphate (-2 e) from the published phosaa14SB TPO template. Requested pH 7 does not calculate or change its protonation state; review bound-state chemistry.
LOW-CONFIDENCE REBUILT SEGMENTS: chain A, insertion position 31, LYS-LEU-GLY-HIS-ARG-SER-GLU-ALA-LYS-ASP-GLY-ILE. These are reconstructed starting models, not experimentally resolved loops.
Ligand protonation is a fixed model choice; it is not a binding-site pKa calculation or a tautomer ranking.
Sidechain adjustment is one bounded steric chi-angle search; it does not establish the correct rotamer or perform exhaustive packing. Any subsequent relaxation is recorded separately.

New loop peptide bonds are initialized trans (proline preserves the candidate cis/trans basin) with temporary construction restraints. These restraints are not included in the simulation; missing-region isomer states remain modeling assumptions.

Energy minimization with the simulation force field is required before dynamics of a rebuilt loop. Construction restraints were temporary; geometry checks do not establish the native loop conformation.

rebuilt_segments.method: ProMod3 loop construction plus bounded OpenMM refinement with observed heavy atoms fixed; construction attempts are recorded in loop-model-provenance.json; no claim of native loop accuracy

sidechain_adjustment.method: One bounded coordinate-descent pass over standard chi bonds; original and −60°, +60°, 180° states; retain only lower steric-overlap scores. No empirical rotamer probabilities or exhaustive packing.
sidechain_adjustment.steric_score: Sum of squared fractional overlaps below 0.78 times summed elemental van der Waals radii; bonded and 1–3 pairs excluded. Dimensionless heuristic, not an energy.
skipped: A:43:ILE (observed loop flank; deferred to loop refinement)
A:56:ASN (observed loop flank; deferred to loop refinement)
sidechain_adjustment.loop_flank_policy: Immediate observed peptide neighbors retain their preliminary chi coordinates; any permitted movement belongs to the separate bounded loop refinement.

relaxation.reason: Modeled loops receive dedicated refinement: observed heavy atoms are fixed first; one bounded, recorded fallback may relax immediate eligible protein neighbors under restraints.

stereochemistry.method: Signed N/C/CB volume at nonglycine CA and CA/branch1/branch2 volume at ILE/THR CB versus PDBFixer standard templates; supported modified-residue centers (including TPO CB and HYP CG) versus their CCD ideal geometry. Absolute volume must exceed 0.0001 nm³.

preparation.template_placement: Scoped proper-rotation Kabsch alignment (det R=+1) replaces PDBFixer 1.12 reflection-capable _overlayPoints during heavy-atom/loop placement.

added_atom_stereochemistry.method: Correct only newly built standard sidechain branches by attachment-plane reflection; no observed atom movement or atom renaming.

stereochemistry_after.method: Signed N/C/CB volume at nonglycine CA and CA/branch1/branch2 volume at ILE/THR CB versus PDBFixer standard templates; supported modified-residue centers (including TPO CB and HYP CG) versus their CCD ideal geometry. Absolute volume must exceed 0.0001 nm³.

loop_construction.coordinate_preservation_scope: Construction transplant only: original observed coordinates are unchanged when missing atoms are inserted. The separate final refinement report records any explicitly restrained neighboring residues allowed to move.

initial_stereochemistry.method: Signed N/C/CB volume at nonglycine CA and CA/branch1/branch2 volume at ILE/THR CB versus PDBFixer standard templates; supported modified-residue centers (including TPO CB and HYP CG) versus their CCD ideal geometry. Absolute volume must exceed 0.0001 nm³.

modeler.context_limit: Only observed residues plus missing-atom repairs enter the quantized PDB context. Unattached ligands/waters may be omitted by ProMod3; complete-complex refinement and final environment checks are required.
modeler.validation_scope: Loop candidate only; requested missing atom inventory never expands. Temporary context residues may move but only missing coordinates are transferred before fixed-heavy refinement and independent geometry/chirality gates.

construction.acceptance: Candidate only; original observed coordinates and final geometry gates are enforced by the caller.

context_warnings.note: ProMod3 may standardize this temporary scoring context to its parent. No observed atom is exported.
The fragment scoring context omits some nonprotein molecules from the input. Complete prepared-force-field refinement and full retained-environment geometry checks are required before acceptance.

randomness.path: Staged fragment search; native Monte Carlo fallback only for unresolved gaps.
randomness.note: The high-level native APIs do not expose a requested-seed parameter. Native Monte Carlo defaults to seed 0; cross-platform bitwise reproducibility is not claimed.

worker_report.method: Staged fragment search with at most two temporary context residues, then bounded native Monte Carlo. Only originally missing atoms are exported; original observed coordinates, fixed-heavy refinement and independent geometry validation are required.

last_worker_progress.acceptance: Candidate only; original observed coordinates and final geometry gates are enforced by the caller.

refinement.method: OpenMM LocalEnergyMinimizer with the prepared force field and temporary peptide construction restraints, NoCutoff, no constraints; all non-loop heavy atoms fixed by zero mass. Loop atoms and regenerated hydrogens mobile.
refinement.energy_comparison: Both endpoint energies use the final construction strength; per-phase energies use that phase's strength.

peptide_construction_restraints.assumption: New non-Pro peptide bonds initialized trans; Pro bonds retain the candidate cis/trans basin. Native isomer states of missing residues are unknown.

refinement.scope: Local starting-geometry relaxation before periodic solvent equilibration; no convergence or native-loop claim. Stereo and geometric acceptance are checked separately.

final_geometry.method: Gross nonperiodic heavy-atom geometry screen for all modeled loop residues; not a native-loop, rotamer, Ramachandran or energy validation.

criteria.other_heavy_bonds: 0.70–1.25 times summed elemental covalent radii (C/N/O/S/P); generous gross bounds, not equilibrium lengths
criteria.contact_exclusions: self, directly bonded and 1–3 atom pairs; hydrogen contacts excluded

modified_residue_parameters.ptr_improper_correction: Restore the four native Amber PTR ring improper quartets by atom name after generic template matching; numeric terms unchanged. Fully assembled System.xml records the portable result.
modified_residue_parameters.reference: Raguette et al. (2024), phosaa14SB and phosaa19SB: Updated Amber Force Field Parameters for Phosphorylated Amino Acids. JCTC 20, 7199–7209.
modified_residue_parameters.normalization: Only atom type identifiers are namespaced for OpenMM amber14/protein.ff14SB.xml. Exact phosphorus type/LJ entries are copied from the same upstream amber/ff14SB.xml. Only SEP/TPO/PTR residue templates are exposed. Charges, numeric parameters, classes, and retained residue graphs are unchanged. PTR improper atom ordering is corrected separately by register_modified_forcefield(); use the assembled System.xml for portable exact terms.
modified_residue_parameters.protonation: SEP/TPO/PTR use fixed -2 phosphate states; HYP is neutral. No residue pKa calculation or automatic phosphate titration.

ligands.stereo_limitations: Carbon tetrahedral CCD/input-SMILES configurations are checked. Nitrogen inversion, atropisomerism, and phosphorus stereodescriptors after ionization are not validated; the original bound heavy-atom pose is retained.

charge_rounding.method: Uniform numerical correction of demonstrated three-decimal SQM Mulliken-output rounding; native AM1-BCC charge differences retained.

ligands.parameter_reuse_note: Identical ordered chemical states share parameters from the first bound copy; each copy retains its own heavy-atom coordinates.

atom_mapping.method: Verified native atom names, elements and bonds; symmetric graph permutations are not used.

sequence_mapping.method: Exact mmCIF _pdbx_poly_seq_scheme positions; author numbering gaps are not interpreted as missing sequence
